description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView for displaying log messages received via the LogNode interface. It formats log entries, handles threading for UI updates, and supports chaining of log nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log messages received through the LogNode interface, with formatting and thread safety considerations.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and appends a log message, then updates the UI in a thread-safe manner, and passes the message along to the next LogNode if connected.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a String to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the String is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line of log data in the LogView.
